mainEntity.name: How can I determine my visa number?

acceptedAnswer.text: On your physical visa sticker or e-visa document, check the section labeled File Number or Residence File No. It typically includes the Emirate code and the year of issuance.

mainEntity.name: What is the number on my UAE residency visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your UAE residency visa number is a unique identifier connected to your visa and residency records. It is different from your permanent UID number.

mainEntity.name: Which section of the visa has the visa number?

acceptedAnswer.text: The visa number is usually attached to a formatted code on the visa sticker or e-visa document. The last 7 to 9 digits generally represent the residency visa serial number.

mainEntity.name: How many numbers are in a UAE residency visa code?

acceptedAnswer.text: A UAE residency visa code includes the Emirate code, the year of issue, and a serial visa number that is typically 7 to 9 digits long.

mainEntity.name: How do I obtain my UAE visa number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your visa number can be found on your passport’s visa sticker or your e-visa PDF. You can also retrieve it online through the GDRFA government portal.

mainEntity.name: Why do we need this visa code?

acceptedAnswer.text: The visa number enables authorities to track the status, validity, renewal, authenticity, and cancellation of an individual's visa.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Dubai freelance visas are valid for one or two years. Highly skilled professionals may also qualify for the UAE Green Visa, which allows residency for up to five years.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of a two-year freelance visa in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: A two-year Dubai freelance visa package typically costs around AED 10,500. This usually includes the freelance permit, Emirates ID, establishment card, and residence visa processing fees.

mainEntity.name: Can I get an Emirates ID with a Dubai freelancing visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, obtaining an Emirates ID is mandatory when you hold a Dubai freelance visa. It is an official identification document required for renting property, opening a bank account, and accessing government services.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a local sponsor for a freelance visa in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: No local sponsor is required for a Dubai freelance visa. It is a self-sponsored visa, allowing you to work independently and maintain full control over your freelance activities.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a freelance visa in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Dubai freelance visa allows you to work with multiple clients, earn tax-free income, sponsor family members, and enjoy residency benefits such as opening a bank account and obtaining a UAE driving license.

mainEntity.name: What are the requirements to become a freelancer in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: To become a freelancer in Dubai, you must obtain a freelance permit from a recognized Free Zone authority, prove relevant skills or qualifications, and successfully complete a medical fitness test.
